name: velocity scales a note on and leaves a release alone
about: velocity multiplies a note on's velocity, rounds to nearest with ties away from zero, clamps to 1..127, and never touches a note off or a note on at velocity 0.
notes: out velocity = clamp(round(v * scale), 1, 127), only on a note on with v > 0. Round is to nearest, ties AWAY FROM ZERO, as everywhere in the core.
The scales are 0.25 and 2, both exact in binary, so the products are exact and a C port in fixed point gets the same ties.
l1 to soft is scale 0.25, l2 to loud is scale 2. Outputs follow link order, soft before loud.
t 0: v 100 (64). soft 25 = 19. loud 200 clamps to 127 = 7F.
t 1: v 102 (66). soft 25.5, a TIE, away from zero 26 = 1A. Truncating would give 25. loud 204 clamps to 7F.
t 2: v 1 (01). soft 0.25 rounds to 0 and CLAMPS UP to 1 = 01. Without the clamp it would be 90 3E 00, which is a release. loud 2 = 02.
NEGATIVE CONTROL t 4: a note off with release velocity 64 (80 3C 40) passes unchanged to both. Scaled it would read 80 3C 10 and 80 3C 7F.
NEGATIVE CONTROL t 5: a note on at velocity 0 is a release and passes unchanged as 90 3D 00. Scaled and clamped it would become 90 3D 01, a note on that never ends.
NEGATIVE CONTROL t 6: a CC value is not a velocity, B0 07 64 passes unchanged.
NEGATIVE CONTROL: l3 asks for scale 0 and is refused bad-args, since a scale must be above zero.
